headline: Per-share loss persists into the second quarter
summary_short: Muyuan Foods reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of -HK$0.86, a loss. A prior-quarter EPS of -0.22 is on the shard but denominated in CNY, so it is not directly comparable to the HKD figure.
summary_long: The only KPI available on the shard for this period is EPS, reported at -HK$0.86 — a loss. The prior quarter's EPS of -0.22 is also negative, but is denominated in CNY versus the current HKD figure, so no percentage delta is computed across the mismatched currencies. No revenue, margin, cash, or year-over-year figures are available from the wire feed for this period.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data. Muyuan's interim results announcement (HKEXnews, filed 2026-08-24, https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0824/2026082400343.pdf) was located via WebSearch, but the fetch returned an unparseable binary PDF stream — no sanctioned PDF-to-text tool exists in this repo (extract-doc-text.mjs handles HTML only), so filing depth could not be attempted. The shard's only populated metric is eps_usd, whose current value (-0.86328) is labelled HKD while its prior_qq value (-0.22) is labelled CNY; the currency mismatch means no honest q/q delta could be computed, so delta_basis is 'none'. No prior_yy, revenue, or margin data is present on the shard.
